scope: Conditional on the fixed original feature matrices; inputs/response histories do not regenerate with synthetic updates. Not human trajectories or a biological power calculation.
null_mean: current PE, exactly representable as a unit complex conditional mean by B
positive_mean: current PE + .35 * clipped[-3,3] standardized residual past-absolute-error state; residual projection fitted on development features only
noise: person normalSD.1rad plus block/context-restarted stationary AR1 rho.35 SD.5rad, independent of fixed features
calibration_rule: Positive>=80/100 and null<=10/100 are a finite fixed-generator interpretation check, not confidence guarantees.
